data.title: Iranian FM Araghchi threatens to halt talks if 'US threats' continue | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Araghchi was likely responding to a Monday interview where US President Donald Trump threatened Iran, saying, "We're going to make a deal, or we're going to finish the job."
